title.zh: 向陆路交通管理局转授职能
title.en: Assignment of Function to Land Transport Authority of Singapore

completenessNote: 该法规为单篇法律文书，无分节结构；正文按官方 front 抬头逐字全录，共 1 条。

text.en:
Land Transport Authority of Singapore Act
(Chapter 158A, Section 6(3))
Assignment of Function to Land Transport Authority of Singapore
N 1
G.N. No. S 162/2003
REVISED EDITION 2004
(31st December 2004)
[31st March 2003]
The Minister for Transport has assigned to the Land Transport Authority of Singapore, the function of promoting, facilitating and providing financial grants for training and education relating to public transport.
